name: Atlantic Flyway Shorebird Initiative
summary: Grants to conserve and restore habitat, reduce disturbance and predation, and fill monitoring gaps for American oystercatcher, red knot and whimbrel along the Atlantic flyway, including Caribbean and South American wintering sites.

geography.label: U.S. Atlantic seaboard, gulf coast, Caribbean and South America

amount.note: Upper and lower limits are not specified.

reporting: Grantees report on metrics they choose from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system.

eligibility.rule: Not a business or unincorporated individual
Address how projects directly and measurably contribute to the Business Plan goals
Piping Plover projects are implemented and completed before 2030
Piping Plover projects have at least three years of baseline breeding data at the proposed site

co_finance.applies_to: All projects except the Piping Plover award

documents: Statement of Litigation, except for federal, state and local government applicants
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or a statement that none exists
GAAP Audited Financial Statements, if not current in Easygrants
IRS Form 990, if not current in Easygrants
Single Audit, if not current in Easygrants

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, U.S. Federal government agencies, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal Governments and Organizations, educational institutions, and international organizations.

geography.quote: This program focuses on priority shorebird sites along the U.S. Atlantic seaboard, the gulf coast and priority wintering sites for the focal species, including portions of the Caribbean and South America.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

amount.quote: The majority of awards under this program will fall in the $75,000 to $200,000 range.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of a 1:1 non-federal match of cash and/or in-kind services is required and will be considered in application review.

reporting.quote: has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting

effort.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Thursday, November 5, 2026, by 11:59 PM Eastern Time

eligibility.quote: Ineligible applicants include businesses and unincorporated individuals.
All proposals must address how projects will directly and measurably contribute to the Atlantic Flyway Shorebird Business Plan goals.
Projects must be implemented and completed before 2030.
Projects must have a minimum of three years baseline data available on the number of breeding pairs and productivity at the proposed site

co_finance.quote: A minimum of a 1:1 non-federal match of cash and/or in-kind services is required and will be considered in application review.

after_award.quote: At the project scale, individual grants will be required to track relevant metrics from Table 3 for demonstrating progress on project activities and outcomes and to report out on them in their interim and final programmatic reports.
